channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: “I Cannot Love Digit 5”: Agility Co-Founder Explains His Robot’s Compromises
item.description: Jonathan Hurst says Digit 5 is the robot Agility needs today, but not the one he dreamed of building. His essay explains the commercial demands behind that tension.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure’s Humanoid Has Walked 348 Miles on a Treadmill—and It’s Still Going
item.description: Brett Adcock says Figure 03 has covered 348 miles in a treadmill stress test that began as a side project to expose failures—and is still running.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Tesla Makes Its Case for Board Continuity Ahead of December 3 Shareholder Vote
item.description: Tesla’s new shareholder letter urges the re-election of Musk, Denholm and Straubel, citing its AI and manufacturing ambitions ahead of the December 3 meeting.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: From Moonwalking to Heavy Lifting: KAIST Humanoid v0.9 Moves 35 kg Objects
item.description: KAIST’s latest humanoid demonstration uses onboard vision to push objects up to 35 kg and lift up to 20 kg, extending its work from locomotion to object handling.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility Taps Logistics Veteran Mark Vale for Board Role Ahead of Merger Vote
item.description: Agility has named Mark Vale as its expected post-merger audit committee chair. Shareholders are scheduled to vote on the transaction on November 2.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Phybot Packs 23 Active Degrees of Freedom Into Its New Robotic Hand
item.description: Phybot debuted its PhyHand at the Canton Fair with 23 active degrees of freedom. The hand demonstrated gestures, while fine grasping remains in development.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figurobot Gives AI a Moving Face With Its 11-Inch FR-NIA Companion
item.description: FR-NIA pairs a silicone-covered expressive face with conversational AI and customization tools, but its Kickstarter launch and pricing details remain inconsistent.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Can a Simulated Robot Score Predict Real Performance? X Square Releases X2Real
item.description: X2Real tests robot manipulation across 44 tasks, with hardware comparisons that reveal both the promise and limits of simulation-based evaluation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Musk Puts Optimus and Cybercab at the Center of Tesla’s Future Value
item.description: Musk says Optimus and Cybercab will account for most of Tesla’s value, while a factory observer describes a building-first approach to the Texas Optimus plant.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AiMOGA Heads Home With Mobo, Opening Robot Pre-Orders on October 21
item.description: AiMOGA plans an October 21 launch for its family companion humanoid, with pricing and delivery details still undisclosed.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Devanthro Becomes Plim Robotics, Reveals a Home Robot Loved Ones Can Step Into
item.description: Plim combines household assistance with remote operation by family and caregivers. The wheeled robot has Jetson Thor computing and a listed two-hour runtime.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree’s UniUni Lets Operators Choreograph Robot Teams With Natural Language
item.description: Unitree’s new UniUni system combines natural-language choreography, LiDAR stage mapping and live robot monitoring to coordinate multi-robot performances.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Nine Minutes to Recharge: Agility Picks Nyobolt for Digit 5’s Long Working Day
item.description: Nyobolt is behind Digit 5’s planned nine-minute recharge, which Agility says will help the humanoid work more than 20 hours per day. Early access is expected in 2027.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: NEURA Gives Its Robot AI Touch, Sound and Memory Ahead of 11-Minute Laundry Demo
item.description: NEURA introduces its multisensory Neuron AI model and plans an autonomous 4NE1 laundry-handling demonstration at GTC Berlin on October 20–22.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Swedish Startup 120ft Wants to Fit a Humanoid-Run Factory Into Three Containers
item.description: 120ft has emerged from stealth with €576,000 in angel funding to develop local robotic assembly for small batches, with brands paying per finished product.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Rhoda Blindfolds Its Robot—and Lets Touch Guide the Search
item.description: Rhoda combines tactile sensing with its Direct Video-Action model to guide manipulation without vision, showing textured-ball retrieval and recovery from mistakes.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: RoboParty Opens RP1 Humanoid Designs, From Mechanical Parts to Motion Policies
item.description: RoboParty has released RP1 hardware files, software resources and motion-policy checkpoints, following its IROS debut and promised broader rollout.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agility Moves Closer to Nasdaq as Merger Vote Is Set for November 2
item.description: The SEC has declared the merger registration effective, bringing Agility closer to its planned AGLT listing and financing for Digit 5 deployments.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Shanghai Wants 8,000 Humanoid Robots in Factories by 2028
item.description: The city has set a factory-deployment goal within a broader AI manufacturing initiative, though supplier allocations and procurement details remain unspecified.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Boston Dynamics Says Atlas Takes a Day to Build—and Wants to Cut That to an Hour
item.description: A new video details in-house machining and rapid assembly, with a speaker describing a roughly one-day robot build and an ambition to reach an hour next year.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Humanoids Summit Founder Modar Alaoui Releases The Humanoid Economy
item.description: Published by Wiley, Alaoui’s new book examines the capital, manufacturing, policy and public acceptance needed to scale humanoid robotics.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Physical Intelligence Opens API Beta for Robot Model Training and Inference
item.description: PI is accepting applications for a managed robot-model API, with early examples spanning manufacturing and heavy machinery.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Astra, Opus and Argon Show How Frontier AI Models Are Speeding Up Robotics Development
item.description: New Astra and Opus demonstrations echo Google’s Argon workflows, accelerating simulation and controller development while exposing the need to verify generated experiments.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Dynamic Creatures Introduces Hugo, a Furry Character Robot With 43 Actuators
item.description: The startup shows Hugo in a new video and outlines work on a Vision-Language-Expression model, navigation and safety for guest interaction.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon Takes Apollo From Human Video to Seven Straight Cornhole Shots
item.description: Google demonstrates Argon using video, simulation and physical feedback to develop robot skills, alongside an 87% embodied-reasoning benchmark score.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Galbot’s PASSAGE Helps Humanoids Step Over, Duck Under and Squeeze Past Obstacles
item.description: PASSAGE learns from human motion to navigate clutter, with onboard Unitree G1 tests and distinct results for destination-reaching and contact-free traversal.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: This Week’s Newsletter: Agility’s $300M Order, Optimus Hands and Two Interviews
item.description: Our October 13 briefing explores Digit 5’s economics, Optimus’s hand challenges and our Aether and Monolithos interviews. Read it and subscribe for free.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Musk Details Optimus Hand Challenges, Warns of Slow Initial Production Ramp
item.description: At X Takeover, Musk described the hand durability and supply-chain challenges behind Optimus, saying magnet export restrictions delayed the program last year.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: South Korea Approves 20-Robot Robros Trial Across Industrial Sites
item.description: A regulatory-sandbox approval opens industrial testing for 20 Robros humanoids as the company targets a manufacturing-focused AI model in the first half of 2027.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Asimov Releases Python SDK, Announces Open-Source Edge Control Layer
item.description: Menlo Research releases a Python SDK for Asimov 1 and announces plans to open its controller-arbitration layer, extending the humanoid’s developer tools.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
